SELECT
  ar.id AS rule_id,
  ar.tenant_slug,
  ar.action_type,
  ar.action_config,
  b.customer_phone AS phone,
  b.customer_name,
  s.name AS service_name,
  b.start_time,
  wt.phone_number_id,
  b.created_at AS booking_created_at
FROM wa_automation_rules ar
JOIN tenants t ON t.slug = ar.tenant_slug
JOIN wa_tenant_config wt ON wt.tenant_slug = ar.tenant_slug
JOIN bookings b ON b.tenant_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN services s ON s.id = b.service_id
WHERE ar.trigger_event = 'booking_confirmed'
  AND ar.enabled = true
  AND b.status = 'confirmed'
  AND b.customer_phone IS NOT NULL
  AND b.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '70 minutes'
  AND b.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '70 minutes' - COALESCE((ar.action_config->>'delayMinutes')::int, 0) * INTERVAL '1 minute'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_messages wm
    WHERE wm.numero = b.customer_phone
      AND wm.metadata->>'rule_id' = ar.id::text
      AND wm.created_at >= b.created_at
  )
LIMIT 20

SELECT
  ar.id AS rule_id,
  ar.tenant_slug,
  ar.action_type,
  ar.action_config,
  c.phone,
  c.name AS customer_name,
  wt.phone_number_id
FROM wa_automation_rules ar
JOIN tenants t ON t.slug = ar.tenant_slug
JOIN wa_tenant_config wt ON wt.tenant_slug = ar.tenant_slug
JOIN customers c ON c.tenant_id = t.id
WHERE ar.trigger_event = 'customer_inactive_30d'
  AND ar.enabled = true
  AND c.phone IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_messages wm
    WHERE wm.numero = c.phone
      AND wm.metadata->>'rule_id' = ar.id::text
      AND wm.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '31 days'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bookings b
    WHERE b.customer_phone = c.phone
      AND b.tenant_id = c.tenant_id
      AND b.start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  )
LIMIT 20

INSERT INTO whatsapp_messages (
  tenant_id,
  mensaje_id,
  numero,
  contenido,
  tipo,
  direccion,
  estado,
  metadata,
  related_entity_type,
  related_entity_id
) VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE slug = '{{ $json.tenant_slug }}'),
  gen_random_uuid()::text,
  '{{ $json.phone }}',
  '{{ $json.resolvedMessage }}',
  'text',
  'outbound',
  'sent',
  jsonb_build_object('rule_id', '{{ $json.rule_id }}', 'automation', true),
  'automation_rule',
  '{{ $json.rule_id }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (mensaje_id) DO NOTHING
